War is not the answer for the crisis in Ukraine. 

I’ve joined @USProgressives in a resolution calling for a diplomatic solution instead of war. 

.@POTUS must exercise all available diplomatic avenues for a peaceful solution. 

https://t.co/vz0ESWwSi9

Today is National Black HIV & Aids Awareness Day.

A day in which we recognize disproportional impact HIV & AIDS has on the Black community. 

We need to continue to work to end the stigma and provide the resources necessary for equal access to treatment and prevention. https://t.co/7uxI6fwwgn

Working families have plenty to worry about & the last thing they should be concerned about is baby formula for their infants.

Next week the House will vote on a bill to immediately address this issue & help ensure infants receive the nutrition they need.

We will get this done.
I have sent a letter along with nine Members of Congress to @SpeakerPelosi, @SenSchumer, and @rosadelauro urging them to extend Puerto Rico’s Nutrition Assistance Program (NAP) by $1 billion.

Join me now as I hold a forum on hunger, nutrition, and health. 

Click the livestream link below: https://t.co/vzEiAgpcgL

Yesterday, myself & @gillibrandny led 15 colleagues in the House & Senate in a letter to Congressional leadership requesting Congress pass an emergency funding bill to support Puerto Rico’s response to Hurricane Fiona that includes $1 billion for the Nutrition Assistance Program. https://t.co/wbLHcrCrAn

The #ACA marketplaces are officially open through Jan 15th!
 
It’s time to #GetCovered with reliable and affordable health insurance.
 
To enroll in health coverage click the link below:
https://t.co/92no9ty7Dn
The reality that millions of children wake up each day without enough food to eat or a safe place to sleep is completely at odds with the promise and ideals of America.

Today, the @US_FDA officially made it easier for patients in many states to access safe, time-essential abortion care. 

By eliminating unnecessary restrictions on #MedicationAbortion, many patients across the country will be able to continue to access care at home!

If the reports are true, then it would be very unfortunate that a Democratic Governor is using the same inhumane treatment we have seen from his Republican counterparts.

https://t.co/6Xc4txGfUl

The treatment of inmates in solitary confinement detailed in this article is truly appalling. 

It's time close Rikers and end this humanitarian crisis.
https://t.co/3SVm5PxBKC

Trump's inhumane immigration policies are a stain on our history that should never be recreated. 

Biden was right to end family detention. Our country must never repeat the horrific treatment of migrants by the past administration.

https://t.co/v3LPhWcHiZ

PR’s current nutrition assistance program doesn’t meet the needs of Puerto Ricans in the wake of recent hurricanes and COVID.
 
I'm proud to lead the Closing the Meal Gap Act with @SenGillibrand, which will expand SNAP to the Island and increase baseline SNAP benefits for all. https://t.co/NLM7r8Z5hz

Today, I toured the START Treatment & Recovery Center in Fort Greene.

START is the US’s largest minority, non-profit agency, providing treatment for substance abuse and other health issues.

I will continue to work to ensure facilities like START have the resources they need. https://t.co/Sun7NaDKv8

My office is monitoring the situation at Woodhull and is working with stakeholders and leaders to make certain that transferred patients get the care they need.

Woodhull is the largest public medical center in North Brooklyn, and we must ensure safety & continuity of care.
Thank you to the staff at Woodhull for continuing to  serve patients during this most challenging time.

Yesterday, a MAGA court in Texas ruled hospitals in the state aren't obligated to perform abortions even if a woman's life is at risk.

Republicans will stop at nothing to ban abortion nationwide. We must continue to fight to codify reproductive rights at the federal level.

This week, I was proud to be recognized by @CHCANYS for my work on behalf of CHCs in New York.

NY CHCs serve more than 2.3M patients yearly regardless of ability to pay, insurance & immigration status.

It is crucial that Congress #FundsCHCs to ensure this vital work continues. https://t.co/vHJKcCh1f1

Health care decisions should be made between patients and providers, NOT judges and politicians. #Mifepristone has been @US_FDA approved for 20+ years.

This case threatens to turn the clock back on access to safe abortion care.

We cannot afford to go back.

This article lays out the health care crisis in PR in brutal detail.

Vastly lower payments to doctors in the Medicaid system have forced doctors to flee the island.

The outcome for patients who stay is longer waits to see a doctor, which pushes them to seek care elsewhere.

For the past 48 years, the #HydeAmendment has left 8 million women on Medicaid without abortion coverage & stripped their freedom to access abortion care nationwide. 

Now is the time to end Hyde & put women's reproductive health care over politics.

The Biden-Harris Administration and Democrats made Medicare stronger and are saving seniors 1000s on Rx drugs. 

Don’t wait to get the coverage you need: Medicare Open Enrollment runs now until December 7.      

Visit https://t.co/xU1DH1y9cB to get started.

Robert Brooks & Messiah Nantwi should still be alive today.

Their deaths are symptoms of a broken prison system that allows rampant abuse and neglect.

This week I joined @JusticePolicy to call for real reforms that end this cruelty and bring accountability to NY state prisons. https://t.co/2PLvK1WReG

The Republican budget would slash $715B from healthcare, gutting Medicaid and causing nearly 14M Americans to lose coverage.

These cuts jeopardize the lives of thousands in underserved communities already struggling to access basic care.

Protect Medicaid. Protect lives. https://t.co/dMtST2AiLx
